brief: A taut plant fibre archery bowstring released and vibrating, a brief low elastic twang with a little wooden bow creak. Three isolated short bowstring plucks with quiet gaps. Dry close Foley.
A wooden digging stick scraping slowly through crumbly dry earth. Long gritty low scrapes and fine grains of soil trickling down. Close dry outdoor Foley, one source.
Dry hemp rope rubbed slowly against itself in bare hands. Soft raspy plant fibre friction, gentle dry creaking and a faint fibrous rustle. Close dry Foley, one source.
